verdict.rationale: Fenwick has a dedicated trademark practice page documenting clearance, registration across 180+ jurisdictions, prosecution of 32,000+ applications, and handling of 3,500+ active trademark disputes (enforcement), plus a custom trademark extranet for docket/portfolio management. This covers clearance, registration, and enforcement as a distinct practice area with strong first-party documentation. Missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration beyond firm's own site.
